questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical security hardening and disruption management capabilities for CKAD-level Kubernetes deployments.

## Key Concepts
- Container SecurityContext: runAsNonRoot, runAsUser, readOnlyRootFilesystem for container isolation
- PodSecurityContext: fsGroup for proper file permissions on PVC-mounted volumes
- Kernel capabilities: drop ALL to minimize attack surface
- PodDisruptionBudget: maintain minimum healthy pods during maintenance
- Rollout and rollback procedures for safe deployments

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-gateway
  labels:
    app: api-gateway
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api-gateway
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1001
      containers:
      - name: api-gateway
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 10001
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - "ALL"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /srv
        - name: config
          mountPath: /etc/app
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: api-gateway-pvc
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: api-gateway-config
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: api-gateway-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-gateway
```

## Verification & Rollback
```bash
# Verify under load
kubectl exec deployment/api-gateway -- curl http://localhost:8080/health
kubectl top pods -l app=api-gateway
kubectl get pods -l app=api-gateway --watch

# Rollback if needed
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-gateway
kubectl rollout status deployment/api-gateway
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to compose a small, repeatable namespace-scoped app using InitContainers, volumes, and secret/config data. It also checks understanding of namespace governance via ResourceQuota, LimitRange, and NetworkPolicy.

## Key Concepts

- InitContainer run-before-main-container ensures content is prepared at startup
- EmptyDir volumes for ephemeral assets; ConfigMap/Secret mounted as files
- ResourceQuota and LimitRange to cap per-namespace usage
- Namespace NetworkPolicy to restrict egress to allowed endpoints
- Minimal YAML skeletons and clear trade-offs

## Code Example

```yaml
# ConfigMap
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: content-config
data:
  CONTENT_URL: "https://content-api.local/assets"
```

```yaml
# Secret (base64-encoded token)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: content-secret
type: Opaque
data:
  API_TOKEN: <base64-token>
```

```yaml
# Deployment skeleton (2 replicas) with InitContainer and volumes
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: static-content-host
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: fetch-assets
          image: curlimages/curl:7.83.1
          command: ["sh", "-c", "CONTENT_URL=$(cat /config/CONTENT_URL); TOKEN=$(cat /secret/API_TOKEN); curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer '$TOKEN $CONTENT_URL -o /assets/index.html"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: assets
              mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
            - name: config
              mountPath: /config
            - name: secret
              mountPath: /secret
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          volumeMounts:
            - name: assets
              mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
      volumes:
        - name: assets
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: content-config
        - name: secret
          secret:
            secretName: content-secret
```

```yaml
# Service
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: static-content-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: static-content-host
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      protocol: TCP
  type: ClusterIP
```

```yaml
# ResourceQuota (namespace-wide)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: ns-quota
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "4"
    requests.memory: 8Gi
    limits.cpu: "8"
    limits.memory: 16Gi
    pods: "10"
```

```yaml
# LimitRange (default limits)
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata:
  name: ns-limits
spec:
  limits:
    - max:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 2Gi
      min:
        cpu: "100m"
        memory: 128Mi
      default:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 512Mi
      defaultRequest:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
      type: Container
```

```yaml

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-egress-to-content-api
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 203.0.113.0/24
```

```yaml
# minimal skeleton for the CronJob (CKAD-style)
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: data-retention-purge
  namespace: default
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          initContainers:
            - name: install-utils
              image: alpine:3.18
              command: ["sh", "-c", "apk add --no-cache coreutils curl jq"]
              volumeMounts:
                - name: logs
                  mountPath: /logs
          containers:
            - name: purge
              image: alpine:3.18
              envFrom:
                - configMapRef:
                    name: retention-config
              env:
                - name: API_KEY

                    secretKeyRef:

            - name: logs
```

```yaml
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gitops-runner
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gitops-runner
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gitops-runner
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: git-clone
        image: alpine/git:latest
        env:
        - name: REPO_URL
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:

              key: repo-url
        - name: TARGET_PATH
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: gitops-config

        - name: workspace
          mountPath: /workspace

        - /bin/sh
```
